description: Define a Java class and instantiate objects from it, identifying fields, methods, and constructors.
Apply encapsulation by restricting field access with private modifiers and exposing controlled getters and setters.
Use inheritance with the extends keyword to share and specialize behavior across parent and child classes.
Distinguish valid method overloading by varying parameter lists within a single class.
Implement method overriding so a subclass replaces a parent method while preserving its signature.
Explain how polymorphism lets one reference type invoke different runtime behavior through dynamic dispatch.
